summary: The cited source adds explicitly selected host mode to the existing portable Executor. A distinct host codec shares the existing journal key and lock, persists the original reservation/lifecycle/optional workload receipt, and flushes cleanup Unknown before crossing the destructive callback. Recovery does not invoke the effect-capable runner recovery port. Independent lifecycle reconciliation can settle missing cleanup acknowledgement without replaying workload or cleanup, while conflicting evidence clears the receipt cleanup projection and preserves the original workload result. Inner cleanup and independent outer retirement remain separate. The component accepts supplied observations; it does not authenticate a host adapter, establish directory-rename durability across machine failure, activate hosting, grant native cleanup authority or establish installed acceptance. Compilation and tests require their exact-head native evidence; source code alone is not qualification.
title: Opt-in host executor retains original lifecycle without authenticating external evidence
